name: Toy Module-LWE generation and exact classical references
purpose: Validate the instance algebra and decoding objective before any QAOA encoding.
status: exploratory development cohort, not a held-out evaluation
sampling: 64 consecutive instance seeds; no rejection or outcome-based selection
objective: min over integer w,s of ||q*w + A_expanded*s - t||^2 + ||s||^2
notes: CBD eta=2 is used independently for secret and error coefficients.
n=2, q=17 are tiny toy choices, not ML-KEM parameters.
The least-squares objective is not exact maximum-likelihood decoding for CBD.
Closest-vector recovery and planted-secret recovery are separate measurements.
No BDD promise, QAOA improvement, novelty, or quantum advantage is asserted.
